title: RepoAssure Autopilot Progress Consistency Guard v0.1
objective: Add a local automated consistency guard so Autopilot active/next goal state stays aligned across goal index, progress snapshot, progress Markdown, PLAN, README, and canonical docs.
acceptance: Add or refresh local tests that verify active/next goal state is consistent across goal index, progress snapshot, progress Markdown, PLAN, README, and canonical docs.
Keep the guard local-only and focused on documentation/progress consistency.
Do not change runtime detector behavior, target repositories, deployment state, publication state, customer contact, pricing, or spend.
Record evidence in the standard operations, acceptance, testing, decision-log, and dev-log surfaces.
